newsitem.title: USA: Ariz Palo Verde nuke to ramp down for Sep 6 outage.
newsitem.headline: Ariz Palo Verde nuke to ramp down for Sep 6 outage.

text.p: The 1,221 megawatt (MW) unit 2 at the Palo Verde nuclear power plant in Arizona will begin Sunday to slowly coast down to between 60 and 80 percent power by September 6, when it is scheduled to shut for refueling, a spokesman for the plant said Wednesday.
The unit's operating rate will drop by one-half to one percentage point a day, spokesman Jim McDonald said.
Unit 2's refueling outage is expected to last 50 days.
Palo Verde's other two 1,221 MW units were said to be operating normally.
Arizona Public Service Co, a subsidiary of Pinnacle West Capital Corp, is the majority owner and operator of the Palo Verde plant.
